descriptor: Boutique studio offering letters of engagement

voice.summary: Lantern & Pine Studio writes like a studio founder with a good pen: courteous, exact and a touch old-fashioned. It treats a signature as a small ceremony.
dos: Use dates, references and full names in letters
Describe ink and pen details with care

taglines: A letter worth putting a name to
Ink, paper and your own hand
boilerplate: Lantern & Pine Studio is a boutique studio that sends clients a letter of engagement and invites them to sign it on screen with a handwritten, replayable flourish.

logo.note: A lantern flame suits the name and gives the signature page a warm, desk-lamp feel.
